title: Illustration use / Neighbourhood text page on pink

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Separate explanation from illustration so the reader can follow the text while the image supplies context.
strategic_value: A pink page with varied residents and housing can give Helsinki informational copy a recognizable human setting.
demonstration: A heading and two text paragraphs occupy the left; building, plant, person with dog and wheelchair user form a right-hand cluster, with a small logo below the text.
practical_value: Keep the explanatory column distinct from the illustration cluster while using a shared background.

content_islands.name: Text column
content_islands.spec: Place heading and two paragraphs at left with the framed logo near the bottom.

content_islands.name: Neighbourhood cluster
content_islands.spec: Arrange building, plant and residents across the right half with cropped edges.

reference_purposes.Application: The page demonstrates body copy beside a group of neighbourhood illustrations.
reference_purposes.Expression: Pink, green and ochre connect the separate subjects through one background.
